title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Rosalind Research through restricted access
dek: OpenAI is bringing GPT-6 Rosalind Research to approved life-science customers, with organization and user approvals rather than a general ChatGPT release.
lede: OpenAI began a limited rollout of GPT-6 Rosalind Research on October 30 for approved life-science customers. Research teams need approval for both their organization and individual users before they can deploy it.

body.text: The release notes place the model in Work, Codex and the API, outside the Chat tab. Access depends on Rosalind Research approval. An organization with Discovery approval still needs separate Research permission for this rollout. Enterprise administrators can enable approved users during the preview and configure access for the period that follows.

OpenAI describes the release as a change in research access and safeguards around an existing model foundation. Its system-card addendum says Rosalind uses GPT-6 Astra weights, with no additional training data or post-training for this release. The foundation therefore stays the same while the conditions for using it in biological research change.

The access process makes governance part of the deployment work. OpenAI reviews proposed uses, security controls and governance practices before granting access. Approved enterprise users need a legitimate research purpose, and qualified people must review outputs before consequential decisions. A lab planning an integration needs to assign those review responsibilities alongside its technical setup.

Existing GPT-5.5 Rosalind Research workflows remain available under the release notes. That gives approved teams a way to compare their current process with the new deployment. A useful evaluation would keep the research task and human review process fixed, then record whether the new system changes the work required to reach a reproducible result.

claims.text: The release notes specify a two-week Enterprise Admin Preview, disabled by default.
OpenAI says the release uses GPT-6 Astra weights without additional data or post-training.
OpenAI has not provided a general-availability date or evidence here of improved clinical outcomes.

buildersNote: Before enabling the two-week Admin Preview, confirm Research approval for the organization and each intended user. Assign a qualified reviewer for outputs that could inform consequential decisions.
